# FleetFlow TMS

> All-in-one transportation management system built for owner-operators, Landstar BCOs, and small fleets. Track loads, IFTA, maintenance, settlements, and driver pay in one place.

FleetFlow TMS is operated by JeanWay USA. It provides load management, financial tracking, IFTA fuel-tax automation, maintenance scheduling, driver settlements, CRM, and dispatch tools for independent trucking businesses.
